scope: Correct the current Metal2Vulkan record using the project's current README, manifests, release history, and license text.

fields.platform: Metal AIR/LLVM IR shaders and a documented subset of Metal-shaped API programs → SPIR-V and Vulkan pipelines; the published runtime requires a Vulkan 1.2 device. Building the Rust libraries requires Rust 1.98 or newer.
fields.status: Alpha; the current repository manifests declare version 0.2.0, while the README says that version is not on crates.io and the crates.io 0.1.0 listing is an unrelated earlier design. The latest GitHub release tag remains v0.1.0 (2026-07-22). The README describes typed refusals for unsupported inputs and states that APIs and outputs can change during the 0.x series.
fields.summary: A Rust workspace with a Metal AIR/LLVM IR-to-SPIR-V translator and a separate Metal-shaped runtime over Vulkan. The current README documents compute, render, tessellation, tile, and mesh stages and a Vulkan 1.2 device requirement; unsupported or not-yet-covered inputs fail with a refusal instead of claiming an equivalent pipeline. The authored validation suite compares selected cases against Metal, while the private corpus is not included in the public repository, so the project does not imply complete Metal compatibility.
fields.source_available: Public source; the repository declares dual licensing under GPL-2.0-or-later OR LGPL-3.0-or-later. GitHub's license detector reports NOASSERTION; the prior catalog value of MIT was incorrect.
fields.subtype: Metal AIR shader translator and partial Metal API runtime
